I wrote it that way because Muninn has no license decision on record. The decision catalog covers https, certificate verification, rustls and caching, and nothing else. The only license mentions are two bare, conflicting one-line notes from separate sessions, "GPL-3.0" and "Apache-2.0". Neither was framed as a decision, so I didn't treat either as one. The `LICENSE` file in the repo is MIT, but nobody recorded that as a decision either, so the document doesn't mention it.

If you want a value recorded, tell me which license and I'll update the file.
